rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_constrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.73979, n_angles=2304, n_det=736, det_spacing=1.285044, sod=595.362, sdd=1086.803, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, train_n=400, val_n=214, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.7, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=mayo_ldct_2d, rationale=iter-3 EXPLORATORY: DC-strength lever. iter-2 (steps16) hit PSNR 32.22dB, still 1.9dB below LD-FBP floor 34.08 -> hr pinned 0; NFE exhausted (20.5min, over budget).
